شَخِيسٌ (assumed tropical:) An affair, or a state of affairs, (أَمْرٌ,) disorganized, disordered, or unsettled; syn. مُتَفَرِّقٌ. (K.) ―
-b2- (assumed tropical:) Speech in which is a sour, a crabbed, or an austere, look: (JK: [like شَخِيصٌ:]) or (tropical:) incongruous, or discordant, speech; (O, K, TA;) as also ↓ مُتَشَاخِسٌ , (A 'Obeyd, TA, in art. شخص,) and مُتَشَاخِصٌ. (K ibid.) ―
-b3- [A man] adverse to that which he is commanded to do. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
